Use LIT:* only for non-entity attributes like numbers, dates, durations, codes, or descriptive text that is not an entity name. For literals, prefer the most specific xsd:* datatype; use ext:* for common syntactic patterns (email, ipv4/ipv6, phone, uuid, url, postal/country/currency codes); if unsure, use the high-level LIT:STRING, LIT:NUMBER, or LIT:DATETIME.
